notes.title: Poon Puzzle Hitting Switch Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I'm actively working on the Nintendo Switch port of Poon Puzzle! I can't wait to release it, but there's still some polishing to be done before I can do that.
Many improvements have been made to the NS version of the game, here's just a few:
[list]
[*]Smooth animations: zooming, rotating and flipping the pieces are now animated smoothly!
[*]Better controls: Both touch and gamepad controls have been improved.
[*]New levels: All levels have been redesigned; the DLC is already included in the game!
[*]More languages: The game is now available in 15 languages: English, 日本, 中文, 中國人, 한국인, Français canadien, Español (LATAM), Português (LATAM), Français, Русский, Italiano, Deutsch, Español (EU), Nederlands, Português (EU).
[*]20% discount will be applied on pre-order.
[*]Switch 2 support!
[/list]

There are some drawbacks though: Nintendo does not allow naked pussies on the screen. For Asian players, naked nipples are also forbidden.

Special thanks to Calamibuddy for the new, more consistent and narrative popups and PlayZilla for porting the game!

Stay tuned!
Cheers!

notes.title: Nintendo Switch version of PumPum available!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey, everyone! A [url=https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/PumPum-2588214.html?s=countries][b]Nintendo Switch™ version of PumPum[/b][/url] is now available! Together with PlayZilla.studio we ported the game, and it was much more difficult than expected. Both the art, GUI, and code needed numerous changes and optimizations, but now I'm proud to announce that the game is available for pre-order on the Nintendo eShop for 25% off (!). Just in case some of you didn't know, unlike Early Access on Steam, pre-ordering on Nintendo eShop means that the game is 100% ready and has passed their (very strict, by the way) review process. It's set for release on August 8.
[/h2]
-What's new?
-PumPum NS features Local Multiplayer and Endless game modes as well as countless amount of improvements.

-What makes it unique? 
-You won't find other games with sexy animated girls and naked boobs on NSwitch! The game is unique. It took a long time to discuss the content with Nintendo and thankfully they allowed the game to be released.

-Why does it cost so much? $20?!
-Because it has more girls! Almost ALL of the girls from the PumPum DLC are included in the default NSwitch version. And, of course, don't miss out on the pre-order discount!

-No naked breasts for Japanese, Korean and Hong Kong players?
-Unfortunately, that kind of stuff is not allowed by local regulators and Nintendo.

-What about Germany and Australia?
-Don't blame me, blame your governments.

I guess not all of you are Nintendo Switch fans, but porting the game took me so much time and effort that I think it deserves a mention.

I'll also be releasing a couple more DLC for other games!

Whoo000pee!
